I'll create a Crossplane XRD and Composition using functions mode with `function-patch-and-transform`. Let me build this out with all required components and environment-aware parameters.

## Directory Structure

```
crossplane/
├── xrd.yaml
├── composition.yaml
├── functions.yaml
├── examples/
│   ├── claim-dev.yaml
│   └── claim-prod.yaml
└── providerconfigs/
    ├── aws-provider-config.yaml
    └── secretstore.yaml
```

## 1. Composite Resource Definition (XRD)

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappinfras.platform.example.org
spec:
  group: platform.example.org
  names:
    kind: XAppInfra
    plural: xappinfras
  claimNames:
    kind: AppInfra
    plural: appinfras
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: appinfra-aws
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      description: Deployment environment.
                      enum:
                        - dev
                        - prod
                    region:
                      type: string
                      description: AWS region to deploy into.
                      default: us-east-1
                    namePrefix:
                      type: string
                      description: Prefix for all provisioned resource names.
                    providerConfigName:
                      type: string
                      description: Name of the AWS ProviderConfig to use.
                      default: default
                    database:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        engineVersion:
                          type: string
                          default: "15.5"
                        masterUsername:
                          type: string
                          default: appadmin
                      required:
                        - masterUsername
                    oidc:
                      type: object
                      description: OIDC provider details for IRSA role trust.
                      properties:
                        providerArn:
                          type: string
                          description: ARN of the EKS OIDC provider.
                        providerUrl:
                          type: string
                          description: Issuer URL of the EKS OIDC provider (no https://).
                        serviceAccountNamespace:
                          type: string
                          default: default
                        serviceAccountName:
                          type: string
                          default: app-sa
                      required:
                        - providerArn
                        - providerUrl
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - namePrefix
                    - oidc
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    name:
                      type: string
                    namespace:
                      type: string
                  required:
                    - name
              required:
                - parameters
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                dbEndpoint:
                  type: string
                irsaRoleArn:
                  type: string
```

## 2. Functions Registration

```yaml

apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.org/v1beta1

metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.7.0
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.org/v1beta1
kind: Function

  name: function-environment-configs
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-environment-configs:v0.1.0
```

## 3. Composition (functions mode)

The composition uses the AWS provider families (`provider-aws-s3`, `provider-aws-rds`, `provider-aws-iam`). Environment-specific sizing is driven by patch transforms with `map`/`match` keyed off `spec.parameters.environment`.

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: appinfra-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppInfra
  writeConnectionSecretsToNamespace: crossplane-system
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        # ---------- Common patches applied to every resource ----------
        patchSets:
          - name: common-provider
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.labels[env]

        resources:
          # =========================================================
          # S3 BUCKET
          # =========================================================
          - name: s3-bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  forceDestroy: false
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common-provider
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-assets"
              # Export bucket ARN to status
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

          # ---- Versioning: enabled ----
          - name: s3-bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common-provider

          # ---- Server-side encryption: AES256 ----
          - name: s3-bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common-provider

          # ---- Public Access Block: block all ----
          - name: s3-bucket-pab
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common-provider

          # =========================================================
          # RDS SUBNET/SECURITY are assumed pre-existing per env;
          # here we provision the RDS instance itself.
          # =========================================================
          - name: rds-postgres
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  # sizing patched below per environment
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  storageType: gp3
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  # security
                  deletionProtection: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
                  maintenanceWindow: "sun:04:30-sun:05:30"
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  autoGeneratePassword: true
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    key: password
                    # name/namespace patched below
                    name: placeholder
                    namespace: crossplane-system
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
                  # name patched below
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common-provider
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-postgres"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.engineVersion
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.engineVersion
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.masterUsername
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.masterUsername
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Convert
                      convert: ToLower

              # ---- Environment-driven instance class ----
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: db.t3.micro
                      prod: db.t3.medium

              # ---- Environment-driven Multi-AZ ----
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: "false"
                      prod: "true"
                  - type: convert
                    convert:
                      toType: bool

              # ---- Environment-driven backup retention (prod longer) ----
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: "7"
                      prod: "30"
                  - type: convert
                    convert:
                      toType: int64

              # ---- Password secret ref name (unique per claim) ----
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-master-password"

              # ---- Connection secret name ----
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-conn"

              # ---- Export endpoint to status ----
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
            connectionDetails:
              - name: db-endpoint
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
              - name: db-port
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
              - name: db-username
                fromConnectionSecretKey: username
              - name: db-password
                fromConnectionSecretKey: attribute.password

          # =========================================================
          # IAM ROLE FOR SERVICE ACCOUNTS (IRSA / OIDC trust)
          # =========================================================
          - name: iam-irsa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  # assumeRolePolicy patched below to inject OIDC trust
                  assumeRolePolicy: ""
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-app-irsa"
              # Build OIDC trust policy from combined fields
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.providerArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.providerUrl
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.providerUrl
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.serviceAccountNamespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.serviceAccountName
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Principal": { "Federated": "%s" },
                            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                            "Condition": {
                              "StringEquals": {
                                "%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
                                "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"
                              }
                            }
                          }
                        ]
                      }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.irsaRoleArn

          # ---- Least-privilege policy for the IRSA role ----
          # Scoped to the app's own bucket. No wildcard actions.
          - name: iam-irsa-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Policy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  policy: ""
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-app-policy"
              # Scoped, explicit actions on the app bucket only
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Sid": "AppBucketObjectAccess",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": [
                              "s3:GetObject",
                              "s3:PutObject",
                              "s3:DeleteObject"
                            ],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s-assets/*"
                          },
                          {
                            "Sid": "AppBucketList",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": [ "s3:ListBucket" ],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s-assets"
                          }
                        ]
                      }

          # ---- Attach policy to role ----
          - name: iam-irsa-attachment
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicyAttachment
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  policyArnSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
```

## 4. ProviderConfig + SecretStore (per environment)

Environment isolation is achieved with **distinct ProviderConfigs** (different credentials / accounts / regions) referenced by name in the claim.

```yaml
# providerconfigs/aws-provider-config.yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-dev
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds-dev
      key: creds
---
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-prod
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds-prod
      key: creds
```

```yaml
# providerconfigs/secretstore.yaml
# DB connection secret is written by Crossplane to a Kubernetes Secret,
# then synced to an external store (never plaintext in Git).
apiVersion: secrets.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: StoreConfig
metadata:
  name: vault
spec:
  type: Vault
  defaultScope: crossplane-system
  vault:
    server: https://vault.internal:8200
    mountPath: secret/
    version: v2
    auth:
      method: Token
      token:
        source: Secret
        secretRef:
          namespace: crossplane-system
          name: vault-token
          key: token
```

## 5. Claims (dev / prod)

```yaml
# examples/claim-dev.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppInfra
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: dev
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    namePrefix: webapp-dev
    providerConfigName: aws-dev
    database:
      engineVersion: "15.5"
      masterUsername: appadmin
    oidc:
      providerArn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
      providerUrl: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
      serviceAccountNamespace: default
      serviceAccountName: app-sa
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-dev-conn
```

```yaml
# examples/claim-prod.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppInfra
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: prod
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    namePrefix: webapp-prod
    providerConfigName: aws-prod
    database:
      engineVersion: "15.5"
      masterUsername: appadmin
    oidc:
      providerArn: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
      providerUrl: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
      serviceAccountNamespace: default
      serviceAccountName: app-sa
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-prod-conn
```

## How this maps to the acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Where satisfied |
|---|---|
| **Bucket versioning** | `BucketVersioning` → `status: Enabled` |
| **Bucket encryption** | `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` → `AES256`, `bucketKeyEnabled` |
| **Bucket no public access** | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` → all four blocks `true` |
| **RDS deletion protection** | `deletionProtection: true` |
| **RDS backup ≥ 7 days** | base `backupRetentionPeriod: 7`; prod mapped to `30` |
| **RDS not public** | `publiclyAccessible: false`; `storageEncrypted: true` |
| **Secret never plaintext** | password auto-generated by provider, written to K8s Secret + synced to Vault via `StoreConfig`; connection secret via `writeConnectionSecretToRef` |
| **IAM least privilege** | scoped `s3:Get/Put/Delete/ListBucket` on the app bucket ARN only — **no wildcard actions** |
| **Env isolation** | separate `ProviderConfig` (`aws-dev`/`aws-prod`) + separate namespaced claims → independent managed-resource trees |
| **Sizing per env** | `map` transforms on `environment` for `instanceClass`, `multiAZ`, `backupRetentionPeriod` |

## Notes / extension points

- **Cluster (EKS)** and **CloudFront + ACM (HTTPS)** from the full spine are typically split into their own XRDs (`XCluster`, `XEdge`) to keep the composition focused and reusable; the IRSA role here consumes the EKS OIDC provider ARN passed in via `spec.parameters.oidc`. I can add those XRDs/Compositions if you want the complete spine in one bundle.
- **Cross-region replication** (prod bucket → `us-west-2`) would add a `BucketReplicationConfiguration` + destination bucket + replication IAM role, gated by an `environment == prod` patch — happy to wire that in.
- To keep sizing logic centralized instead of inline `map` transforms, you can add an `EnvironmentConfig` per environment and the `function-environment-configs` step (already registered in `functions.yaml`) to select it by `spec.parameters.environment`.

Want me to add the EKS cluster + CloudFront/ACM XRDs and the prod cross-region replication resources to complete the full canonical spine?
